name: Tachibana Yayako
source:
Yayako is a new student at Seio who becomes a treasurer of the student council. [url=/c10948]Sakura[/url], her senpai, calls her "Yaya-pyon" (she hates this name), and she calls her "Tsuchii" in return.
She had entered the student council by Sakura's recommendation. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
